Topic 7.3: Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns, part of Strand 7 in SNE  /  visual-impairment / Grade 8 ENGLISH.

Key inquiry question: How do we use indefinite and reflexive pronouns in communicatio n? 2. Why do we use indefinite pronouns?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Grammar in Use 7.3.1 Word Classes: Pronouns together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
● Citizenship: The learner listens to an audio clip on wildlife from a digital device hence empowering the learner to care for

natural resources and the environment.

● Collaboration: The learner participates actively in groups to enhance their knowledge on indefinite and reflexive pronouns.

Values:
Respect: The learners work in groups and respect each other’s opinions

Link to other subjects:

Kiswahili, German, French, Arabic and Chinese -Indefinite and reflexive pronouns are taught in all these languages

Suggested Learning Resources:

• Audio clip

• Charts, tactile charts

• Refreshable braille display - Braille me

• Orbit reader

• Digital devices with assistive technology
